fallback: static calibration tables baked into the module
note: Swaption vol is returned in bp/yr normal vol — backend divides by 100 then multiplies by √T. bdh pulls 5 days of history. Edit _fetch_swap_rates() and _fetch_swaption_vols() in Python to change.

series.description: USD swaption ATM normal vol — ticker combines expiry and tail (e.g. USSN6M10Y, USSN1Y5Y, USSN3M30Y). Valid expiries: 1M, 3M, 6M, 1Y, 2Y, 3Y, 5Y, 7Y, 10Y. Valid tails: 1Y, 2Y, 5Y, 10Y, 15Y, 20Y, 30Y.
